name: Digital arrest scam
redFlags: Caller claims to be police or CBI, says you are involved in a crime, demands money or stays on a video call. No agency does 'digital arrest'.
action: Hang up. Do not pay. Report at 1930 or cybercrime.gov.in.

name: Fake KYC update
redFlags: Message says your bank account will be blocked unless you update KYC through a link.
action: Do not click. Contact your bank through its official app or branch.

name: Lottery or prize scam
redFlags: You are told you won something you never entered, and must pay a fee or share details to claim it.
action: Ignore and delete. Never pay to receive a prize.

name: Malicious APK / fake app
redFlags: A link asks you to install an app outside the Play Store, often disguised as a bank, utility or government app.
action: Do not install. Only use official app stores.

name: Fake job offer
redFlags: Easy high pay for simple tasks, asks you to join Telegram or pay a registration fee.
action: Do not pay. Verify the company on its official website.

name: Fake loan app
redFlags: Instant loan with no checks, asks for contact and photo access, later harasses you.
action: Only borrow from RBI-registered lenders. Report harassment at 1930.
